# openmetadata_bot (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata bot by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_bot" "reporting" {
  fully_qualified_name = "reporting"
}

output "reporting_bot_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_bot.reporting.id
}

output "reporting_bot_user" {
  value = data.openmetadata_bot.reporting.bot_user
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Bot fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Bot UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `bot_user` (String) Name of the user the bot is bound to.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `name` (String) Bot name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
